home.title: Your tasks, most urgent first
home.text: Everything due today is here. The button on each row is the one thing to do: Reply, Send link, Approve, Message.

home.title: This week at a glance
home.text: Messages against your target, replies, gifts on the way, content due and the content rate. Each one says how it compares.

home.title: Pipeline and team
home.text: Where every creator stands, and what the team did last. Open board takes you to the lanes.

creators.title: Find or add someone
creators.text: Search by name, handle, email or place. To add a creator, paste their profile link under Add creator.

creators.title: Open a creator for the whole story
creators.text: Click a name: journey, messages, gifts, content and history on one page.

creators.title: Who delivers
creators.text: Ranking sorts everyone by content delivered, Amazon sales, followers or engagement.

pipeline.title: Five lanes
pipeline.text: To contact, In conversation, Gifting, Content due, Done. Drag a card to the next lane to move the creator.

pipeline.title: Narrow it down
pipeline.text: Search, Filter by owner, platform or followers, or tick Only mine.

pipeline.title: List, review queue and settings
pipeline.text: List shows every status in a table; the review queue holds new candidates; Settings has the timers.

gifts.title: One row per order
gifts.text: Tick rows to approve, copy addresses or cancel several at once. Click a row for the address, the rules and tracking.

gifts.title: By status
gifts.text: Needs approval first, then To order, Shipped and Delivered.

gifts.title: The Amazon file, then tracking
gifts.text: Export the Amazon order file at the top, upload it in Seller Central, then paste the tracking back here.

reports.title: Pick a period
reports.text: This or last week, month or quarter, or any two dates. Narrow to one campaign on the right.

reports.title: Four figures
reports.text: Each one beside the same figure for the period before, so you can see the direction.

reports.title: Where creators drop off
reports.text: Contacted to posted, step by step, and the biggest leak in words.
